exposure: expectant management of concomitant tubal ectopic pregnancy (EP) after IVF/ICSI
surgical therapy for concomitant tubal EP after IVF/ICSI
outcome: need for surgical or medical treatment of EP
cohort: Patients who conceived with tubal heterotopic pregnancy (HTP) via IVF/ICSI and were treated expectantly between January 2010 and December 2021, matched with controls having solely eutopic pregnancies or HTPs managed surgically.
finding: Expectant management for select women with heterotopic tubal pregnancy following IVF/ICSI resulted in comparable prognoses for concomitant eutopic pregnancies to those managed surgically or solely eutopic pregnancies, significantly reducing the need for surgical or medical treatment of EP.
birth_weight: Measured; average birth weights around 3194-3294g across groups.
gest_age: Measured; average gestational age at delivery around 38.4-38.7 weeks across groups.
